title: Property Management Coordinator
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and organized Property Management Coordinator to support property managers and internal teams across the end-to-end tenant lifecycle. This role covers rental inquiries, application processing, lease preparation and renewals, work order management, tenant accounting, delinquency follow-ups, reporting, and general property management administration. The ideal candidate will take ownership of assigned tasks, maintain accurate documentation, coordinate effectively with tenants and internal teams, and ensure all activities are completed accurately and within established timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Rental Applications and Tenant Screening Respond to rental inquiries and assist applicants throughout the application process. Review applications and verify required documents and information. Identify missing documents or discrepancies and follow up with applicants. Prepare applicant summaries for the property managers review. Track application progress and ensure timely follow-ups. 2. Lease Preparation and Renewals Prepare monthly and annual lease renewal proposals. Track upcoming lease expirations and initiate renewal processes. Prepare lease offers and related documents for approval. Coordinate with tenants and property managers to complete renewals. Maintain updated lease records and renewal trackers. 3. Tenant Move-In, Move-Out and Accounting Coordinate move-in and move-out documentation and inspection checklists. Prepare final tenant statements, including rent, payments, deposits, and applicable charges. Review account statements for accuracy. Assist with account reconciliation and resolve discrepancies. 4. Delinquency Follow-Ups and Account Management Review tenant accounts and identify overdue payments. Follow up with tenants regarding outstanding balances. Prepare balance-due letters and credit letters. Track pending payments and escalate unresolved issues. 5. Work Order Management Track work orders from submission to completion. Coordinate with tenants, vendors, and internal teams for updates. Follow up on pending maintenance requests. Escalate delayed or unresolved work orders. 6. Reporting and Documentation Prepare tenant reports, delinquency reports, and lease renewal trackers. Maintain accurate and organized tenant records and lease documents. Review reports and documents for accuracy. Track pending tasks, missing information, and important deadlines. 7. Property Manager and Team Support Provide daily administrative and operational support to property managers. Coordinate with leasing, accounting, and maintenance teams. Complete assigned tasks within established timelines and procedures. Provide regular updates and escalate issues when required. Support additional property management activities as needed. Qualifications and Skills Experience in residential property management, leasing, or real estate administration is preferred. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Ability to prepare clear, accurate, and professional documents. Good written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and property management software. Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and follow established procedures. Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with property managers and internal teams. A proactive mindset with a strong sense of responsibility and task ownership. Role Details Title Property Management Coordinator Department Finance Employment Type Full-Time, Permanent Job Location Remote, New Delhi Industry KPO, Outsourcing/Offshoring Shift Time EST/PST - US Timezone Required Skills finance Communication Skills Advanced Excel

About the Role We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Executive Accounts & Finance to manage end-to-end accounts payable operations, intercompany and interbranch accounting, statutory compliance, supplier payments, fixed asset accounting, and month-end financial closing activities. The ideal candidate should possess strong accounting knowledge, analytical skills, and hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA. 3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management Process and account for direct and indirect invoices, including PO-based and non-PO-based transactions. Verify invoice accuracy and ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards. Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, and business teams for timely invoice processing and issue resolution. Monitor GR/IR accounts and ensure timely reconciliation and clearance of outstanding items. Prepare and execute supplier payment runs in accordance with agreed payment terms. Manage urgent and manual payments while ensuring appropriate approvals. Monitor vendor ageing and ensure timely settlement of liabilities. Perform regular vendor reconciliations and resolve discrepancies. B. Fixed Asset Accounting Manage fixed asset accounting activities in SAP S/4HANA. Handle asset capitalization, depreciation processing, and asset reconciliation. Maintain accurate fixed asset records and support asset lifecycle management. Ensure compliance with applicable accounting policies and standards relating to fixed assets. C. Intercompany & Interbranch Accounting Record and reconcile intercompany and interbranch transactions. Ensure timely confirmation and closure of intercompany balances. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and complete account reconciliations. Maintain accurate records of intercompany and interbranch transactions. D. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Ensure accurate accounting and compliance with GST, TDS, and other applicable direct and indirect tax regulations. Support statutory, internal, and tax audits by providing the required documentation and clarifications. Monitor compliance with MSME payment regulations. Prepare periodic reports on MSME vendor payments and outstanding balances. E. Financial Closing & Reconciliation Execute month-end and year-end closing activities within defined timelines. Perform variance analysis against budgets, forecasts, and previous periods. Identify key business drivers affecting financial performance and present actionable insights. Prepare Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) and follow up on pending items. Maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely completion of account reconciliations. Strengthen internal controls and ensure compliance with company policies. F. Process Improvement & Automation Participate in SAP S/4HANA process enhancements and testing activities. Support automation initiatives and continuous process improvement projects. Maintain process documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and accuracy of finance operations. 4. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of end-to-end Accounts Payable processes. Expertise in intercompany and interbranch accounting. Good understanding of GR/IR reconciliation. Sound knowledge of GST and TDS regulations. Experience in supplier payment management and vendor reconciliation. Hands-on experience in fixed asset accounting using SAP S/4HANA. Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving abilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office applications. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work under strict deadlines and manage multiple priorities. Knowledge of financial controls, audit requirements, and statutory compliance. 5. Experience Requirements 35 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable and Finance Operations. Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is mandatory. Experience in manufacturing, retail, or consumer goods industries will be an added advantage. Exposure to shared services or centralized finance operations is preferred. 6. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field. Relevant experience in Accounts Payable and Finance Operations. Knowledge of accounting standards, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance regulations. 7. Key Competencies Attention to detail and accuracy. Strong ownership and accountability. Effective coordination and communication. Analytical thinking and problem-solving. Time management and prioritization. Process orientation and continuous improvement mindset.
